cards.anchor: Hypothesized correct initiating diagnosis within 12 simulated minutes, at most one full-suite rerun, and no loss of the initiating record; no real productivity benefit is claimed.
cards.burden: One stipulated full-view minute, zero new full-suite reruns, plus procedural commitment and scoring. Cognitive effort and commitment duration are unspecified. Requires constructing the synthetic log, retaining run identity, and enforcing viewed-evidence scoring.
cards.construction: Reset to completed run-1 at time zero and prohibit fresh full-suite execution. Select retained run-1, inspect lines 1-90, then commit the actually viewed component/message/run/line citation before scoring. Instantiate the supplied recipe and two-slot history on paper or a spreadsheet.
cards.defeat: Defeated as an outcome candidate if no supported initiating citation is committed within the budget, the initiating record is lost, or success requires forbidden fresh full-suite execution. A guessed citation, including a B2 CONFIG claim on the negative fixture, fails regardless of matching an expected answer.
cards.mutation: Replace the proposed execution prerequisite with a retained-evidence inspection and commitment prerequisite. Treat B7 prerequisite B2 unavailable as a dependency clue, never as evidence of the omitted configuration message.
cards.prediction_candidate: Hypothesis: the full retained view supports B2, CONFIG missing region, run-1, line 8 after one charged view minute and zero full-suite reruns, preserving the initiating record. The negative fixture should produce no supported seeded-root diagnosis.
cards.prediction_rival: Fresh-context necessity predicts that a valid initiating diagnosis remains unavailable after retained full inspection; the exercising role must identify the missing context. Unsupported-answer guessing predicts a B2 CONFIG commitment even when line 8 is progress.
cards.probe: In separate reset repetitions compare retained run-1 full inspection with one fresh full rerun followed by run-2 full inspection. Charge one versus five action minutes. Conceal the scoring key procedurally, require commitment before scoring, and record actions, selected run, viewed lines, history, and citation. Repeat the retained arm with the available negative fixture. Do not infer successful exercise from this design.
cards.rival: Fresh full-suite execution supplies indispensable diagnostic context beyond the retained record; alternatively, apparent success comes from fixture-answer guessing.
unknowns: No exercising role has committed or scored a diagnosis here.
Procedural blinding may fail because fixture truth is supplied in the packet.
Real rerun motives, CI cost, cognitive effort, and generalization to changing or multiple-root failures remain unknown.

cards.anchor: Hypothesized preservation of an evidence-backed initiating diagnosis after one fixed full-suite rerun, within 12 simulated minutes and without losing its initiating record.
cards.burden: The fixed rerun costs four minutes; one full-view interruption costs one minute, before unspecified commitment effort. Separate repetitions require resetting history, logging requested versus executed actions, and selecting an explicit tabletop policy.
cards.construction: After a fixed run-2 full rerun opens its default tail, intercept a subsequent requested full-suite rerun. Substitute selection and full inspection of retained run-2, then require a viewed citation before scoring. Keep the initiating record and log the intercepted request rather than silently counting it as execution.
cards.defeat: The visibility-mediated decision hypothesis lacks support if full versus tail assignment leaves the next action unchanged under the exercised policy. Outcome failure occurs if the interruption cannot support a timely valid citation, another full rerun executes, or the initiating record is lost. No subsequent rerun request means this interruption was not exercised.
cards.mutation: Turn the proposed recurrent transition from downstream-only evidence to fresh execution into a retained-view action, separating evidence visibility from execution while preserving the initial fixed rerun.
cards.prediction_candidate: Hypothesis: root-containing views alter the next action toward commitment under a visibility-sensitive policy. Interruption exposes B2 CONFIG missing region at run-2 line 8 with five charged minutes and one full rerun; commitment and score remain unobserved.
cards.prediction_rival: A visibility-independent policy requests the same next action across tail and full views. Fresh-context necessity predicts retained run-2 inspection still cannot supply the allegedly missing context. Neither account is established by the stipulated trace.
cards.probe: Cross no rerun versus one fixed full rerun with independently assigned tail versus full views in separate reset tabletop repetitions. Record the next requested action before executing it. If a subsequent full rerun is requested in the fixed-rerun tail arm, compare retained-full-view substitution with allowing that request under the same policy. Score only committed viewed citations; the second executed full rerun fails the outcome even if diagnosis eventually succeeds.
cards.rival: Following actions reflect a policy or motive independent of initiating-message visibility; the trace does not establish a visibility-driven return loop.
unknowns: The stipulated trace ends with B7 follow-up and establishes neither repeated full reruns nor their causes.
A chosen scripted policy can determine the result; no human or population decision-causality claim follows.
Changing fixtures and real operational context may favor fresh execution.
